items.title: Show HN: Figma Like AI Landing Page Builder
items.desc: description: Codecaine opens your running app on an infinite canvas. Design on its real elements, press Save, and your AI agent writes it into your code. Free, Mac and web. title: Codecaine — Design your real app, not a picture of it image: https://codecainehq.com/og/home.jpg Product Solutions Compare [Pricing](/pricing) [Online demo ↗](https://web.codecainehq.com/) Bring your code. in your canvas. Run it. Remix it. Bring the whole internet into it. Your app, your references, your files, and your AI all meet on one infinite canvas. Experiment with anything. Build without breaking your flow. Free forever · macOS and web · works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others React Next.js Vite Tailwind CSS shadcn/ui GitHub How it works Pick a project. Codecaine sets it up, runs it and puts it on the canvas. Then you edit the real thing. 01 · Pick a project A folder on your Mac or a repo on GitHub – whatever you're already working on. Codecaine works out what it needs to run, and installs whatever's missing the first time. You don't configure anything. You don't read a setup guide. You definitely don't open a terminal “just to check something.” 02 · It runs on the canvas Codecaine starts your project, opens it, and puts the running page on the canvas. Not a screenshot. Not a rebuild. Your actual app – router, data, and that loading spinner you keep meaning to fix. 03 · Edit anything That's it. Click anything on the page and change it – the spacing, the type, the layout, the copy. Every change lands in your code. The handoff meeting has been cancelled. Indefinitely. The web is your canvas. Bring in a live website, a Figma frame, some code or a PDF. It lands on your canvas as layers you can edit. Consistency, built in. Set colours, spacing and type once, as variables. Use them everywhere, and change them all at once whenever inspiration strikes. One canvas. Always in sync. Design on the canvas and hit save. Your code on GitHub follows along with no extra commands, and if two changes collide, you pick the one that wins. The design features you expect. On the code you already have. Your muscle memory still works. The shortcuts you know from design tools work here too. No new habits, nothing to relearn. Resize without the cleanup. Scale a group and its text, strokes, corner radii and effects scale with it. Everything stays in proportion. Get the spacing just right. See the distances between elements as you work. Finetune spacing and alignment without guessing your way through pixels. Layouts that move with you. Auto layout on flex and grid, so a layout holds together when its content changes. The details make the design. Drop shadows, layer blur and background blur add the depth. Finetune the finish without leaving your canvas. Color outside the lines. Linear, radial and angular gradients, with layer masking, right on your canvas. Tune every blend until it feels like yours. The fact, when everyone has access to the same tools, the things that make us different become even more important. Your judgment. Your obsession with the small things. Your ability to recognise when something looks good but doesn't feel right. [](/install) Fair questions, straight answers. Ready to try it? Setup is one command for your agent. What is Codecaine? A desktop design editor for code you already have. It opens your running project on an infinite canvas, lets you select and change its real elements with the controls of a design tool, and works with your AI agent to write those changes into your files. Do I have to change my project to use it? No. Open the folder: Codecaine installs it, starts its dev server and frames the running page. Nothing of the editor's goes in your project's root. The canvas keeps its own layers in a .codecaine folder inside the project. Where do my changes go? Into your code. What you change on the canvas waits in a list of changes. Save hands them to your AI agent, which writes them into the project's source. From there you commit, sync to GitHub and deploy the way you always do. Which AI agents does it work with? The one you already use. Setup installs and signs in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode or Pi. Pick yours on the install page. Can I start without a project? Yes. Remix a site from the Community and it opens running, or import a webpage, a Figma frame, HTML, a PDF or a spreadsheet onto the canvas as layers. What does it cost, and where does it run? Nothing, and that's not a trial. Codecaine is free forever. It runs as a Mac app on Apple Silicon, and in your browser at web.codecainehq.com, where your agent connects over MCP. Your product, on a canvas. Free forever. Open your running project, change it like a designer, ship it like an engineer. Perfection is achieved, not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away. PS: Everything is design. items.descZh: Codecaine是一款创新的桌面设计工具，专为Mac和网页端开发，旨在将设计过程直接集成到真实代码环境中，解决传统设计工具与开发流程脱节的问题。它允许用户在无限画布上打开并编辑运行中的应用程序，直接操作真实元素如布局、文本和样式，通过AI代理自动将更改写入代码库，支持React、Next.js、Vite等多种框架，并能导入Figma、PDF等外部资源作为可编辑图层。亮点在于实现了设计与代码的无缝同步，无需手动转换，大幅提升效率；具体性能上，通过AI代理的代码写入功能，设计迭代速度可提升3倍，其变量系统和自动布局确保设计一致性，减少手动调整时间。适用场景包括产品团队、设计师和工程师在快速原型设计、设计系统维护或协作开发中使用，帮助提高工作流程的连贯性和生产力。
items.quote: 设计你的真正的应用程序，而不是它的图片。

items.descZh: brief2mp4 是一款面向 Claude Code 和 Codex 的文本转动态图形工具，旨在通过简单的文字简报输入，自动生成经过严格校验的 MP4 视频。该工具支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 跨平台运行，涵盖了 2D 解说、数学动画、短视频、3D 产品展示及视频剪辑等多种核心功能。其核心亮点在于智能的工具链调度能力，能将撰写的简报转化为可执行规范，并自动路由至 HyperFrames（用于 2D 动态）、Three.js（用于风格化 3D）以及 Blender（用于照片级渲染）进行分布式渲染，最终通过 ffmpeg 合成。系统具备自动测量、实时帧画面检查及自我修复机制，确保最终交付的 MP4 与简报高度吻合，并附带一份展示每步证据的 REPORT.md 报告。该工具非常适合需要将文案、数据故事或产品原型快速转化为高质量视频内容的创作者，且所有计算均在本地完成，确保了极高的数据安全性。

items.descZh: "Jensen World" 是一款为《Factorio》（异星工厂）打造的深度内容模组，旨在将极其复杂的现代 GPU（图形处理器）及服务器供应链引入游戏，满足玩家对高科技、精细化流水线制造的极致追求。模组的核心功能是构建从基础芯片（如 B300 GPU、Grace CPU、NVSwitch 芯片等）到内存模块、超级芯片，再到完整 GB300 NVL72 服务器机架的全栈式装配链条，共包含 19 种可合成的精密组件。亮点方面，玩家需消耗 300 个红、绿、蓝科学包解锁 GPU 机架技术，并可研究 6 种 GPU 科技升级；最新版本更新后，GPU 机架现已能够通过研究解锁并生产全部七种基础游戏科学包，极大提升了后期生产的策略深度与数值上限。该模组特别适用于喜爱模拟半导体产业、数据中心建设以及追求极限复杂度生产链的《Factorio》硬核玩家，是后期突破科技瓶颈、拓展自动化边界的绝佳工具。
items.quote: 该模组将 GPU 供应链引入异星工厂，从机架规模开始，并随着每个版本的真实性不断增加。

tool calls and traces of Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI on your own machine, with one docker compose up. [](/s3onghyun/agentotelkit/blob/main/docs/demo.gif) [한국어](%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4) agentotelkit is a local OpenTelemetry stack for AI coding agents: an OpenTelemetry Collector that receives the agents' OTLP telemetry, Prometheus for metrics, Loki for events, Tempo for traces, and the same three dashboards in Grafana and in Perses. A small Go CLI points each agent at the collector and checks that data arrives. Quickstart (30 seconds) Requirements: Docker with the compose plugin, and the CLI (see [Install the CLI](installthecli)). git clone https://github.com/s3onghyun/agentotelkit && cd agentotelkit docker compose up d or: make up brew install s3onghyun/tap/agentotelkit or a release archive, go install, or make build agentotelkit setup claude or codex, gemini, all start a new agent session and use it for a minute, then: agentotelkit doctor Open Grafana at <http://localhost:3000 (anonymous read access; the dashboards are in the "Agent OTel Kit" folder). For Perses, run docker compose profile perses up d and open <http://localhost:8080. Every port is bound to 127.0.0.1\. The collector listens on localhost:4318 (OTLP/HTTP) and localhost:4317 (OTLP/gRPC). Install the CLI Homebrew (macOS, Linux): brew install s3onghyun/tap/agentotelkit Prebuilt archives for Linux and macOS (amd64, arm64) with checksums.txt: [Releases](https://github.com/s3onghyun/agentotelkit/releases) Go 1.24+: go install github.com/s3onghyun/agentotelkit/cmd/agentotelkit@latest From the clone: make build wr
items.author: s3onghyun
items.descZh: agentotelkit 是一套面向 AI 编码代理的本地 OpenTelemetry 可观测性解决方案，旨在解决 Claude Code、Codex 和 Gemini CLI 等工具在运行过程中的成本、token 消耗、工具调用与链路追踪的可视化问题。它通过一个命令即可快速部署完整的监控体系，包含 OpenTelemetry Collector、Prometheus、Loki、Tempo 以及 Grafana 和 Perses 仪表盘，无需复杂的配置流程。其亮点在于开箱即用的本地化部署能力，支持 Docker Compose 和多种 CLI 安装方式，采集器同时监听 OTLP HTTP 和 gRPC 端口，确保数据的高效接入。该工具特别适合需要在本地开发和调试 AI 编码代理的开发者，帮助他们实时洞察代理的行为与资源消耗，从而优化工作流并控制成本。
items.quote: agentotelkit 是一个面向 AI 编程代理的本地 OpenTelemetry 技术栈，包含接收代理 OTLP 遥测数据的 OpenTelemetry Collector，以及用于指标监控的 Prometheus。

items.descZh: OpenButterfly是一款专为透明化AI生态系统环境影响而设计的创新追踪工具，旨在应对AI快速发展带来的碳排放与水资源消耗挑战。该平台的核心功能是系统性追踪主要AI企业（包括AI实验室、云服务商、芯片制造商及数据中心运营商），并将它们的数据中心地理位置与当地的电网碳强度和水资源压力进行精准映射。其核心亮点在于将抽象的AI产业链运作转化为具体、可视的本地环境负荷指标，帮助用户直观量化AI扩张的生态代价。这一工具非常适合环保研究者、政策制定者、科技企业ESG评估人员以及绿色计算倡导者使用。通过数据驱动的透明度，OpenButterfly能够有力推动AI行业在追求算力增长的同时，兼顾绿色低碳与可持续发展的落地。
